name: SupplierQualificationAuditManager
tagline: GMP supplier qualification, risk-based audits and the approved supplier list – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete supplier quality app for pharmaceutical manufacturers: quality questionnaires with minimum scores, risk-based audit programme, audit findings and CAPAs, quality agreements and GMP certificates, six approval gates, conditional approval, four-eyes e-signature, suspension and disqualification – with dashboard, supplier register, qualification board and audit plan. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with built-in demo data.
features: Approved supplier list with ASL export
Six approval gates incl. quality agreement and GMP certificate
Conditional approval with end date and conditions
Risk-based re-audit intervals and 12-month audit forecast
Risk index and risk × performance matrix
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control SupplierQualificationAuditManagerPortal)
